# Fixtures

Most `.txt` files here are real PoE2 clipboard item texts copied from the
Exiled Exchange 2 test suite (`renderer/specs/Parser/items.ts`), MIT licensed,
Copyright (c) 2020 Alexander Drozdov. See the repository `NOTICE`.

Hand-written in the observed clipboard format (not from EE2, no real item
behind them): `currency-stack`, `rune-socketable`, `soul-core`,
`plain-rare-markers`, `plain-unique-mirrored-crlf` (CRLF line endings).
